items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: I sang with my dad’s band which consisted of a great guitarist, his name was Alvin Pulley

ctx.x: Which leads me to something I wanted to make sure we talk about, the sometimes mysterious art of accompaniment. And what makes a good accompanist? I was listening to a video of you singing “I’m Shadowing You” and it occurred to me what a wonderful thing it is to be able to accompany yourself. Because you can do like instant arrangements.

Thank you. Yes. And, but it’s a wonderful thing but it’s also, you know I’m now too easily into that in everything I do it’s all of the moment. And being at that daily place where I have the freedom to play a Beatles song and then Art Tatum something, or whatever, same thing. And I never play anything the same way twice. So I’m reinforcing that and I don’t think I’m going to get too structured anymore but yes. But I — and it took a while because I really didn’t hear that much growing up in Woonsocket I heard some…
